score: 1 for recent normal-terminal training pass rate in inclusive band, else0; stable frontier does not require positive learning gain.
coverage: 25% terrain/wave-cap-balanced episode assignment floor across all original tasks, plus75% global frontier allocation. Empty/unknown/allzero/no frontier falls back to100% balanced coverage.
limitations: Explicit heuristic, not a theoretical optimality claim; assignment coverage does not imply equal decisions/ticks/time. No validation labels; truncations ignored as successes/failures and reported.
task_mutation: Separate future version; no mutation of current frozen pool or original validation.
adoption: Optional mainline implementation after short sampler/config checks; no hours-long paired experiment as an adoption gate. Final repeated-learning acceptance unchanged.
